Compassionate Eye Care – Anywhere
Specializing in helping patients maintain visual health and independence at any age, we provide compassionate eye care –
ANYWHERE
.
We are a mobile eye care office, providing quality comprehensive eye exams in non-traditional settings such as:
Schools
Nursing homes
Facilities for the developmentally disabled
Assisted living centers
Retirement homes
